errors.evidence: The figure consists of bar charts, not column charts. The atom checklist specifies 'Balkendiagrammen' (bar charts).
The color for 2022 is described as 'lila' (purple) in the machine-generated description, but the atom checklist specifies 'Violett' (violet).
The description does not explicitly state that the chart shows the share of Russian imports of selected industrial raw materials.
The description omits the tick interval (5%) on the y-axis.

errors.text_span: Die Säulen sind in beiden Diagrammen in der Reihenfolge der Metalle angeordnet, und die Werte sind direkt über den jeweiligen Säulen angegeben.
errors.evidence: This sentence adds unnecessary detail that does not enhance understanding of the figure.
